rows.text: At the core of Wilmar’s strategy is an integrated agribusiness model that encompasses the entire value chain of the agricultural commodity business, from cultivation and milling of palm oil and sugarcane, to processing, branding and distribution of a wide range of edible food products in consumer, medium and bulk packaging, animal feeds and industrial Agri-products such as oleochemicals and biodiesel.
rows.source_sentence: At the core of Wilmar’s strategy is an integrated agribusiness model that encompasses the entire value chain of the agricultural commodity business, from cultivation and milling of palm oil and sugarcane, to processing, branding and distribution of a wide range of edible food products in consumer, medium and bulk packaging, animal feeds and industrial Agri-products such as oleochemicals and biodiesel.

rows.text: As a leading agribusiness group, Wilmar recognises that we have a fundamental role to play in developing quality products required by the world while ensuring we have a responsible and sustainable manner of production.
rows.source_sentence: As a leading agribusiness group, Wilmar recognises that we have a fundamental role to play in developing quality products required by the world while ensuring we have a responsible and sustainable manner of production.

rows.text: Wilmar’s No Deforestation, No Peat, No Exploitation (NDPE) Policy and NDPE Sugar Policy, introduced in 2013 and 2021 respectively, underpin our aspiration to make a positive impact and drive transformation across the palm oil and sugar sectors.
rows.source_sentence: Wilmar’s No Deforestation, No Peat, No Exploitation (NDPE) Policy and NDPE Sugar Policy, introduced in 2013 and 2021 respectively, underpin our aspiration to make a positive impact and drive transformation across the palm oil and sugar sectors.

rows.text: Sugar constitutes close to 10% of our total revenue and this is derived from our sugar milling, processing, merchandising and distribution.
rows.source_sentence: Sugar constitutes close to 10% of our total revenue and this is derived from our sugar milling, processing, merchandising and distribution.

rows.text: Following our pledge at COP26, we worked closely with several of our peers in palm oil industry to develop palm oil sectoral roadmap, which was released at COP27 to collectively accelerate the supply chain action and reduce emissions.
rows.source_sentence: Following our pledge at COP26, we worked closely with several of our peers in palm oil industry to develop palm oil sectoral roadmap, which was released at COP27 to collectively accelerate the supply chain action and reduce emissions.

rows.text: Through the efforts of the sustainability department, climate-related issues ranging from deforestation risks to emissions reduction programs are actively being monitored on the ground and analysed accordingly before reporting back up the reporting line for management review.
rows.source_sentence: Through the efforts of the sustainability department, climate-related issues ranging from deforestation risks to emissions reduction programs are actively being monitored on the ground and analysed accordingly before reporting back up the reporting line for management review.

rows.text: As part of implementation of Wilmar's NDPE policy, our procurement teams are expected to actively verify and filter out companies involved with deforestation (environmental criteria) from their sourcing volumes.
rows.source_sentence: As part of implementation of Wilmar's NDPE policy, our procurement teams are expected to actively verify and filter out companies involved with deforestation (environmental criteria) from their sourcing volumes.

rows.text: If a company has been flagged out due to deforestation risks but is still included in our supply chain, the procurement teams will be negatively impacted during their annual review of performance.
rows.source_sentence: If a company has been flagged out due to deforestation risks but is still included in our supply chain, the procurement teams will be negatively impacted during their annual review of performance.

rows.text: For palm oil mills that are equipped with methane capture and utilization plants in Malaysia, the efficiency of operating the plants to a targeted level is incorporated into the evaluation for appraisals of managers and engineers.
rows.source_sentence: For palm oil mills that are equipped with methane capture and utilization plants in Malaysia, the efficiency of operating the plants to a targeted level is incorporated into the evaluation for appraisals of managers and engineers.

rows.text: Ensuring an efficient methane capture system allows us to realize actual savings in emissions by reducing the amount of methane being released to the atmosphere from the palm oil mill effluent treatment system, putting us on track to meet our emission reduction targets.
rows.source_sentence: Ensuring an efficient methane capture system allows us to realize actual savings in emissions by reducing the amount of methane being released to the atmosphere from the palm oil mill effluent treatment system, putting us on track to meet our emission reduction targets.

rows.text: Also, with the captured methane used to generate supplementary electricity for mills & housing uses, this reduces our reliance on diesel fuel which would have otherwise been used as the fuel source.
rows.source_sentence: Also, with the captured methane used to generate supplementary electricity for mills & housing uses, this reduces our reliance on diesel fuel which would have otherwise been used as the fuel source.

rows.text: For short-term time horizon, the risks and opportunities are characterized to have high likelihood of occurrence in 0-2 years and high financial impact (> US$5 million).
rows.source_sentence: For short-term time horizon, the risks and opportunities are characterized to have high likelihood of occurrence in 0-2 years and high financial impact (> US$5 million).

rows.text: Any on-going governmental regulations, such as methane capture in palm oil mills in Malaysia, must be fulfilled to reduce the climate impact.
rows.source_sentence: Any on-going governmental regulations, such as methane capture in palm oil mills in Malaysia, must be fulfilled to reduce the climate impact.

rows.text: Climate change advocacy groups are looking to influence policy makers to adopt and impose stricter climate-related regulations such as carbon pricing mechanism.
rows.source_sentence: Climate change advocacy groups are looking to influence policy makers to adopt and impose stricter climate-related regulations such as carbon pricing mechanism.

rows.text: For long-term time horizon, the risks and opportunities are characterized to have high likelihood of occurrence after 10 years and high financial impact (> $US5 million).
rows.source_sentence: For long-term time horizon, the risks and opportunities are characterized to have high likelihood of occurrence after 10 years and high financial impact (> $US5 million).

rows.text: Wilmar worked with peers in the palm oil industry to develop a sectoral roadmap released at COP27 to accelerate supply chain action and reduce emissions.
rows.source_sentence: Following our pledge at COP26, we worked closely with several of our peers in palm oil industry to develop palm oil sectoral roadmap, which was released at COP27 to collectively accelerate the supply chain action and reduce emissions.

rows.text: Wilmar defines substantive financial impact as risks or opportunities exceeding US$5 million annually per issue.
rows.source_sentence: To be considered as having substantive financial impact on the business, the potential annual implications (costs/benefits) of such risks or opportunities would have to exceed US$5 million per issue.

rows.text: Wilmar collaborates with Earthqualizer on the Supplier Group Compliance Programme to monitor deforestation risks in its supply chain.
rows.source_sentence: Specifically on deforestation risk (key risk for climate change), Wilmar works together with Earthqualizer on the Supplier Group Compliance Programme to provide proactive monitoring and surveillance of our supply chain to ensure deforestation risks are identified early so that actions can be taken to resolve issues at an early stage.

rows.text: Malaysia's government is considering mandating methane capture plants in all palm oil mills in the near future, with existing regulations already requiring methane capture systems for new mills or expansions.
rows.source_sentence: In Malaysia's example, the government might be looking at the feasibility of mandating methane capture plants in all palm oil mills in the near future. Currently there is already a mandate for new mills or expansion plans for existing mills to include methane capture systems in the designs.

rows.text: MPOB mandates the installation of biogas trapping or methane avoidance facilities in palm oil mills as a condition for new construction or throughput expansion.
rows.source_sentence: For context, the palm oil industry has been regulated by Malaysian Palm Oil Board (MPOB), which is imposing the mandatory installation of biogas trapping or methane avoidance facilities in palm oil mills as a condition for any new mill construction or existing mills applying for throughput expansion in the country.

rows.text: Indonesia is considering imposing a carbon tax on coal-fired power plants, with potential expansion to other industries, including Wilmar's operations.
rows.source_sentence: Similarly, Indonesia is looking to impose carbon tax on coal-fired power plants and there is potential for it be further rolled out to more industries, including those we operate in.

rows.text: Wilmar is implementing methane capture plants at major mills in Malaysia and Indonesia, with an estimated total capital cost of US$90 million for 45 mills.
rows.source_sentence: In order to ensure our operations can meet any potential stricter requirements, we have started working towards implementing methane capture plants at our major mills in Malaysia and Indonesia. With an estimated cost of about US$2 million for a covered lagoon system to capture and utilise the biogas from Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME), the total capital cost to implement the system in all mills (45) in Malaysia, Indonesia, Nigeria and Ghana would be estimated to be around US$90 million.

rows.text: Changing consumer demands for traceability and sustainable production pose a risk to Wilmar's market position if not addressed.
rows.source_sentence: The consumer market is becoming increasingly sophisticated in their demands such as requesting traceability and no deforestation as well as sustainable production for their goods. Thus, by not adapting and aligning with the changing consumer needs, the company stands to lose out in the market against competitors who are updated and kept abreast of such demands.

rows.text: Wilmar's Integrated Policy on NDPE and certifications like ISCC, RSPO, and Bonsucro align with sustainability goals and industry benchmarks.
rows.source_sentence: Alignment of public policy positions with sustainability goals by launching the Integrated Policy on NDPE in December 2013. In addition to the policy, Wilmar is committed to other relevant and globally recognized certifications and standards like International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC), Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) and Bonsucro.

rows.text: Methane capture and utilization from POME allows palm oil mills to replace diesel for electricity generation at minimal operational cost.
rows.source_sentence: With biogas containing high proportion of methane generated from POME being waste energy that is not fully tapped, methane capture and utilization as a fuel source allows palm oil mills to replace diesel for electricity generation at minimal operational cost.

rows.text: Wilmar is actively looking at building more methane capture plants at its palm oil mills to maximize the opportunity.
rows.source_sentence: Depending on the feasibility of building methane capture plants at our palm oil mills, Wilmar is actively looking at building more of the plants to maximize this opportunity.

rows.text: The estimated cost to construct a new methane capture plant with biogas utilization facilities is around US$2 million.
rows.source_sentence: The estimated cost to construct a new methane capture plant with biogas utilization facilities is around US$2 million.

rows.text: China's R&D Centre pledged over US$15.72 million to support scientific research and development.
rows.source_sentence: China's R&D Centre pledged over US$15.72 million (or approximately US$1.5 million per year for 10 years) to support scientific research and development.

rows.text: Wilmar has implemented a No Deforestation, No Peat & No Exploitation policy across its full supply chain.
rows.source_sentence: The most substantial business decision made on the long term strategy was to implement the No Deforestation, No Peat & No Exploitation policy that covered our full supply chain actors as well.

rows.text: Given Wilmar's NDPE policy and sector practices, the company likely addresses workforce health and safety through compliance with labor standards, safety training programs, and grievance mechanisms for workers across its supply chain.

Wilmar probably upholds business ethics through governance structures like its Board Sustainability Committee, adherence to anti-corruption policies, and formal grievance channels for stakeholders to report unethical practices.
